candidate.source_summary: DOM element text content (textContent or innerText) from elements selected via document.querySelectorAll or jQuery selectors. Content originates from HTML markup or previous DOM manipulations.
candidate.sink_summary: DOM text property assignment (textContent/innerText) which can execute HTML/script content if tainted with malicious input
candidate.guard_summary: No explicit sanitization or validation of the text content before assignment. The assignment is a self-assignment intended to restore original text content.
candidate.risk_pattern: Self-assignment of DOM element text property without sanitization, potentially re-introducing previously sanitized or escaped content back into the DOM in executable form
enclosing_conditions: if (span) - when element has already been shaved and contains a shave span

unresolved_facts: Whether the original text content contains sanitized/escaped HTML or script content

Whether textProp assignment (textContent vs innerText) affects HTML interpretation behavior

target_cwe.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
target_cwe.description: The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page that is served to other users.
remediation_steps: Use parameterized queries and prepared statements
Implement strict input validation with whitelisting
